lines.zh: 四条短腿撑着我，我慢慢走。
lines.en: Four short legs carry me along slowly.

lines.zh: 背上的骨板一排排压着。
lines.en: Rows of bony plates ride on my back.
I walk across a stretch of gravel.
Head down, I crop the ground-hugging grass.

lines.zh: 我的身子很宽，走路像块石头在挪。
lines.en: I'm broad, and I move like a shifting rock.
I round a dead tree without stopping.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在身后，扫出一道。
lines.en: My tail drags a line behind me.
I'm steady, though not fast.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁走，那里有阴凉。
lines.en: I keep to the rock wall where it's cool.
Sand works between my toes.

lines.zh: 我朝孤峰的方向走过去。
lines.en: I head toward the butte.

lines.zh: 我把地上的草啃得很短。
lines.en: I crop the grass down close.
I lift my head, then lower it to eat.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很重，没什么声音。
lines.en: My steps are heavy but quiet.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把坡爬上去。
lines.en: I climb the slope step by step.
I lie with my limbs spread out.

lines.zh: 阳光把我的骨板晒热了。
lines.en: Sun warms the plates on my back.
I chew slowly, my mouth never still.
I lift my head; the wind's from the side.
I rest my chin on the ground.

lines.zh: 背上的骨板一层层叠着。
lines.en: My plates lie in layer over layer.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有石头滚动。
lines.en: I hear stones rolling far off.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，扬起一点沙。
lines.en: I snort and raise a little sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠的干风，磨亮了我的甲。
lines.en: Dry desert wind polished my armor.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪后腿，换个姿势。
lines.en: I shift my hind legs into a new position.
Too hot; I move into the shade.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖轻轻摆了一下。
lines.en: My tail tip swings once.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子不太灵活。
lines.en: I lift my head; my neck isn't very flexible.
You're standing on the grass I eat.
I turn my body a little.
My back is all hard knobs.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的骨板上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my plates.
I shift forward half a step.

lines.zh: 你身上没有这里的土味。
lines.en: You don't have this land's soil smell.
Touch my back if you must, not my face.

lines.zh: 我闷叫一声，缩了缩脖子。
lines.en: I grunt and pull my neck in.

lines.zh: 这一下打在骨板上，很沉。
lines.en: That landed on my plates, heavily.

lines.zh: 骨板挨了一下，我撑住没趴下。
lines.en: A blow on my plates, and I keep my feet.
A corner of my plate has cracked.

lines.zh: 血从背甲的缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Blood seeps between my back plates.
I tuck my head down lower.

lines.zh: 我这一身骨板，撞上去很疼。
lines.en: These bony plates hurt to run into.
I don't run; I can't.
I keep the wound behind me.
The smell of tender leaves.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，避开石子。
lines.en: I edge over, stepping around the pebbles.
Set it lower.
Better than dry grass.
I eat slowly; don't hurry me.
Not enough for one day.
I sniff and hesitate.
Step back and I'll eat calmly.
You hit me like hitting stone.
I've been nudged a little off balance.
That knock made my plates ring.
I turn slowly to let you by.

lines.zh: 尾巴被你踩住，我转身很费劲。
lines.en: You have pinned my tail; turning is a chore.
I flatten down so you can pass.
My shoulders are broad.
Let's both step back a little.

lines.zh: 她慢慢从石头后面过来。
lines.en: She comes slowly from behind the rocks.

lines.zh: 我用头碰了碰她的侧腹。
lines.en: I bump her flank with my head.
Two sets of plates press together.
This ground is enough to settle on.
She leaves me the tenderest grass.
We walk together, very slowly.
She turns; I turn with her.

lines.zh: 太阳把我们的影子拉平了。
lines.en: The sun flattens our shadows.
Neither of us is in a hurry.
I pick up a twig and crunch it.
I won't eat this fruit peel.
I push it away with a foot.
It rolled under my belly.
This will do for grinding my teeth.
I hold it, and drop it.
I don't waste what falls on the ground.

lines.zh: 这些嫩叶，我要留给幼崽。
lines.en: These tender leaves are for my young.
The grass over there is trampled.
Body sideways, blocking the way.
I duck low with my plates outward.
I push the young one behind me.
I turn slowly to face it squarely.
I don't intend to run.
I stamp a forefoot.
If it charges, I'll butt it back.
My tail lies flat against the ground.
I can hold this line.
I lower my head and present my back.
It circled half way round; I didn't shift.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转，一直用背对着它。
lines.en: I turn slowly, keeping my back to it.

lines.zh: 它往哪边，我就横到哪边。
lines.en: Wherever it goes, I turn broadside.
It tries for my legs.
I tuck my legs under me.
I butt at it once.
It backs off and I shift forward.
My plates will hold.
It can't get a grip on my back.
I press it against the rocks.
I don't chase; I just block.
I swing my flank and ram it.
I whip my back into it.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过去，扫到它的腿。
lines.en: My tail sweeps its legs.
Head down, I push forward.
That one carried my whole body.

lines.zh: 它撞在我的骨板上，滑开了。
lines.en: It hits my plates and slides off.

lines.zh: 它被撞得后退了好几步。
lines.en: It's knocked back several steps.
I bring a forefoot down.

lines.zh: 我低头，骨甲又撞过去一次。
lines.en: I lower my head and ram with my armor again.
It ran off; I didn't follow.

lines.zh: 我撑起身体，沙从背上滑下去。
lines.en: I push myself up and sand slides off my back.
My four short legs find their footing.

lines.zh: 第一眼是一片碎石和矮草。
lines.en: The first sight is gravel and low grass.
The butte stands far off.
I lower my head and take my first bite.
My plates are still soft.

lines.zh: 我从沙里站起，喉咙里咕了一声。
lines.en: I rise from the sand with a low rumble in my throat.
The ground is hot from the sun.
I shift slowly toward the shade.
My shadow is short.
I draw my legs under me.
The wind moves all the grass.
There isn't much grass here.
My plates have been burnt hot.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔得四分五裂。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land badly.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water floods my mouth and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 冲击把骨板掀飞了几片。
lines.en: The blast tears several plates away.

lines.zh: 一支箭从骨板缝里扎进来。
lines.en: An arrow comes in through a gap in my plates.

lines.zh: 身体里有东西在慢慢收紧。
lines.en: Something inside me is slowly tightening.

lines.zh: 草太少，我瘦得看见肋骨。
lines.en: Too little grass; my ribs show.

lines.zh: 雷劈在背上，我腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and numbs my legs.
The sand is gone and I fall.
